column1: # Second key named in the catalogue: GV c 1950.02.00/1 (CorrespGV3 pagfis 4665-4667), handwritten on Senado Federal
# paper, 1950 (the Amaral Peixoto code). Page 1 lists: cover name - person. Pages 2-3 are notes on the 1950 succession
# in which the cover names are used (Ford, Mercury, Chevrolet, Jeep, Tinoco, Góes, Benedito, Amaral, Agamemnon,
# Brigadeiro, Nereu, Jobim, Adhemar, Salgado). Applied to the 1946 telegram for completeness.
# names at the top of page 1 with no value written: Chateaubriand, Cardeiro (?), Manhães, Osvaldo, Expectativa
# 'copa e cozinha'; page 2 top: Ford - bem, adiante, escolha mais tarde; Mercury - bem, já tendo preferencia;
# Chevrolet - 0; Jeep - mais ou menos (?); Tinoco - conversa Dutra.
